name: joycraft
description: Install and update Joycraft, a skill bundle and runtime for agent-led software work, in any project

joycraft.summary: One-session work now takes a short brief path whose close runs your tests. Feature runs ask fewer questions and print each next command. joycraft update refreshes the AGENTS.md block. The reviewer tries bad input, checks that tests can fail and checks docs against code.

author: Maximilian Maksutovic
